FAQ

Common Questions

Do I need an appointment, or can I walk in?

Walk-ins are welcome, but weekends and late afternoons are often fully booked. We recommend booking on WhatsApp to lock in your time so you don't have to wait. Need to reschedule? Just let us know 3 hours ahead — no charge.

It's my first visit — will I be pushed to buy a package?

No. We charge strictly by the price list. After your treatment, your therapist will share suggestions based on your skin — whether you buy anything is entirely up to you. That's our house rule, and the thing reviewers mention most.

How long does a treatment take?

Facials run about 60–75 minutes, the hot stone massage is 90 minutes, and a haircut takes about 45 minutes. Allow an extra 15 minutes for the analysis and welcome refreshment so you're never rushed.

Is parking easy nearby?

There are public parking bays in front of the shop and behind the same row of shops — weekday daytime is easy. In the evening, park along Jalan Sutera Tanjung instead; it's under a 2-minute walk.

What payment methods do you accept?

Cash, cards, DuitNow QR and e-wallets are all fine. Packages and memberships can be paid in instalments — ask us in-store for details.
